newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks open mostly lower on rate fears.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks open mostly lower on rate fears.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened mostly lower on Thursday after robust housing starts, pointing to a strong economy, knocked almost a half point off the long bond and renewed fears of an interest rate hike.
Dow industrials were off 16 points at 5861. The NASDAQ Index was off two at 1204.
